options.text_cn: 用等价子力换取对方的等价子力，保持材料平衡
options.text_en: Exchange pieces of equal value to maintain material balance

options.text_cn: 主动放弃子力，换取将杀机会或持续的决定性进攻优势
options.text_en: Deliberately give up material in return for a mating opportunity or a lasting, decisive attacking advantage

options.text_cn: 移走己方棋子，暴露后方棋子的攻击线
options.text_en: Move one of your pieces to reveal the attack line of a piece behind it

options.text_cn: 故意送子让对方吃，然后立即赢回同等子力
options.text_en: Offer a piece to be captured, then immediately win back material of equal value

explanation_cn: 弃子是主动放弃子力而不要求换回等价子力。目的不是换子，而是换取将杀或压倒性的进攻优势。弃子的价值在于换取的战略利益大于被弃子力的物质价值。
explanation_en: A sacrifice deliberately gives up material without requiring an equal-value recapture. The goal is not an even exchange, but a mating attack or a powerful, lasting initiative. A sacrifice is justified when its strategic return is greater than the material given up.
